method: Whole-file manual reading of both files; exact pinned bytes verified; compiled original GetDrawableChildCount and ComputeChildSpans with synthetic CItem and Windows integer aliases.

runtime_controls.scope: 9900 nonincreasing four-child size vectors in 0..8 with widths 1..20, shifted origin -7; independent exact rational half-up boundary oracle. One UINT64_MAX parent saturation case. No source algorithm changed.
runtime_controls.adapters: Synthetic CItem exposing size, leaf flag, children; LONG=int32_t, ULONGLONG=uint64_t. Not a Windows application run.

findings: LayoutItem uses an explicit pending stack, reversed child insertion preserves preorder, and vertical coordinate growth stops before LONG_MAX overflow. This removes recursive traversal from this layout path but does not bound total retained geometry.

Child spans saturate cumulative sum at parent size before addition, clamp rounded boundaries, omit zero-width children and let the last drawable child absorb aggregate mismatch. partition_point assumes positive children precede zeros.
PrepareLayout cache key is root pointer, width and effective row height. Mutating the same tree needs external ClearLayout invalidation; this increment does not establish every caller path.

ClearLayout drops item pointers and rows but may retain container capacity. TrimMemory additionally swaps containers to release storage. Borrowed CItem lifetime still depends on model/view coordination.
Hit testing and clip iteration use per-row upper_bound on ordered right edges; rendering visits intersecting rows rather than the entire layout. No measured speedup claim.
Breadcrumbs use one sticky row, nearest ancestors retained when ancestors exceed horizontal pixels. Zero-size root remains interactive.
limits: No full Windows build, GUI, rendering, performance, adversarial deep-tree or concurrency qualification.
Original long-double behavior on Apple clang need not match MSVC floating-point behavior for huge weights.
No foreign production code adopted. Native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains 147/500.
